params.flashloanAmount: Amount provided by flashloan provider; returned exactly.
params.strategyCalldata: ABI-encoded (address token) — the token being cycled, purely                          so this contract can transfer it back for repayment. The                          prior version ignored strategyCalldata entirely and had no                          way to know what token to send back to the Orchestrator —                          fine as an inert stub, but not fine once the Orchestrator                          actually expects every strategy to repay in-kind (see                          OmegaOrchestrator.sol's receiveFlashLoan()).

blocksSinceLastPing().notice: Returns blocks since the last canary ping.

execute(bytes,uint256).notice: Validate execution pipeline. Returns exactly flashloanAmount (zero profit).         Emits CanaryPing for off-chain health monitoring.

secondsSinceLastPing().notice: Returns seconds since the last canary ping.
